title: Create an xSignal between two component pins
summary: Shows how to create a pin pair (xSignal) from pin descriptors with IPCB_PinPairsManager.CreateFromPinsDescriptors, list pin pairs with their node count and length, and delete one.
phrasings: add a pin pair between two pads
list xSignals and their lengths on a board
define a signal path from U1 pin 16 to U4 pin 23

commands.name: CreateXSignal
commands.description: Create an xSignal between two pins
